unit.label: -wise
unit.core_meaning: in the manner of, or with regard to
unit.mentor_note: Wise narrows a claim to one dimension. "Moneywise, the plan works" concedes that in every other respect it might not, and that concession is exactly what a strengthen-or-weaken question hunts for.

members.meaning: in the direction the hands of a clock turn

predict_options.text: With regard to, or in the manner of, the thing named
Knowing a great deal about something

discovery.understand_note: Wise means "in the manner or respect of". It quietly limits a claim to one axis: healthwise good says nothing about cost, taste or time.

applies.prompt: Knowing -wise means "in the manner of", what does clockwise describe?

options.text: Turning in the direction a clock’s hands move
Being good at telling the time
